### Date Slop

An adversarial, interactive Bad UX experiment where an incompetent AI agent hijacks entry of a date input field.

### Core Mechanics

* **Hijacked Input:** The date input field is entirely controlled by an unhelpful AI agent.
* **No Direct Entry:** Users are structurally blocked from typing, selecting, or directly inputting their target date.
* **Clue-Based Loop:** Users must feed the agent contextual text clues to guide it. The agent cannot interpret standard dates natively, forcing a game of "hot or cold" until it guesses correctly.

### Purpose

A web-based satire of over-engineered AI automation, highlighting the friction and absurdity of replacing simple UI controls with conversational agents.

### Technical Details

* **Type:** Single-page Web Application / Game
* **URL:** https://date-slop.hdv.dev/
* **Author:** Hussein Duvigneau
